speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe your symptoms and how long you've been experiencing them. REQUEST TEST: Basic metabolic panel and lipid profile.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your normal metabolic and lipid panels, have you noticed any headaches, vision changes, or snoring at night? Please also tell me if you have a family history of high blood pressure or kidney disease. REQUEST TEST: Renal function panel and plasma renin/aldosterone levels.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any abdominal pain, especially in the right upper quadrant, or noticed any changes in your urine output? I also need to confirm if you have a family history of adrenal disorders like Conn's syndrome or pheochromocytoma. REQUEST TEST: Plasma metanephrines and cortisol level.

speaker: Doctor
text: With all biochemical screens normal, have you noticed any episodes of pounding headaches, palpitations, or sweating, and does your blood pressure vary between arms? REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal ultrasound to evaluate for renal artery stenosis and adrenal masses.

speaker: Patient
text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery, is currently up to date on all vaccines, and is meeting all developmental milestones. His mother reports that he has been generally doing well with no concerns. No family history of cardiovascular disease. The boy does not take any medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Coarctation of the Aorta

Please have the child's blood pressure measured in both the right arm and the right leg immediately. Also, listen carefully for any continuous machinery-like murmur heard best over the left upper back while the patient is in a lateral decubitus position.
